Short answer

To install symfony-cli on Omarchy, open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add symfony-cli. It is a 7.1 MB download (18.5 MB installed), version 5.22.2-1, licensed AGPL3. The Symfony client helps developers create and manage Symfony applications. Free and open source.

On this page Install Open and use Requirements Uninstall Package facts Questions

Install symfony-cli on Omarchy

Symfony CLI is a terminal tool from the Symfony project that scaffolds new Symfony applications, runs a local development web server with HTTPS and Docker Compose integration, and handles day-to-day tasks like checking security advisories in your dependencies. It is aimed at PHP developers working with the Symfony framework and installs once as a single binary.

  1. Open a terminal.
  2. Run the install command:
    omarchy pkg add symfony-cli
  3. Check it landed. Pacman should list version 5.22.2-1:
    pacman -Qi symfony-cli

Open and use symfony-cli

symfony-cli has no window of its own: it is a command-line tool, library or system component. To see the commands it added to your PATH:

pacman -Ql symfony-cli | grep /usr/bin/

No special requirements are documented for symfony-cli.

Frequently asked questions

How do I install symfony-cli on Omarchy?

Open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add symfony-cli. The download is 7.1 MB and it takes 18.5 MB once installed. Omarchy pulls in any dependencies automatically.

Is symfony-cli free?

Free and open source. The package is licensed AGPL3.

How do I uninstall symfony-cli?

Run omarchy pkg drop symfony-cli. It removes the package from your system.

What does symfony-cli depend on?

The package declares 1 dependency: glibc. Omarchy installs them for you.

Is symfony-cli a desktop app?

No. symfony-cli has no window of its own; it is a command-line tool, library or system component.

Is symfony-cli in the official Omarchy repo?

Yes. It is published as symfony-cli (version 5.22.2-1) in the official Omarchy package repository. Symfony CLI makes it. Project site: https://symfony.com/.
